title: 🚫 Never Publish an AL Extension with Missing Translations Again
summary: A VS Code extension that validates translation files are present before publishing AL extensions, manages regional language variants, and visually highlights incomplete translations. It helps developers prevent missing translations for required markets.
key_points: Enforces required languages through VS Code configuration and validation commands
Automatically handles regional language variants like es-ES_tradnl and fr-CH as equivalents of base languages
Creates or syncs regional variant translation files from base language files
Highlights incomplete translations in g.xlf and language-specific files with configurable visual indicators
Displays language status tooltips when hovering over highlighted entries

quotes.text: nothing prevents you from publishing an extension without a language for the markets that really need it
quotes.why_it_matters: Identifies the core problem the extension solves - incomplete translations slipping through to production

quotes.text: This extension validates that required language translation files are present, manages regional variations, and highlights incomplete translations as you work.
quotes.why_it_matters: Summarizes the three main capabilities that address translation file management throughout development
